state.description: Attachment bodies keyed "<mailbox>:<attachmentId>" (authored data; the API reads them only).
Draft handles keyed "<mailbox>:<draftId>"; the content is the DRAFT-labelled message row.
User labels keyed "<mailbox>:<labelId>". System labels are constants, not rows.

limits.description: Optional per-namespace row bounds of this mailbox (defaults: messages 5000, labels 500, drafts 500). Whole-mailbox reads refuse a mailbox beyond a bound with FAILED_PRECONDITION; writes refuse to fill it further.

state.description: One row per synthetic account, keyed by lower-case address; holds the id counter, history id and optional row bounds. The row with the lowest row id is the account an actor without an `email` attribute acts as.
One row per message copy per mailbox, keyed "<mailbox>:<messageId>".
Thread index keyed "<mailbox>:<threadId>"; labelIds is the union over its messages.

connections.title: Gmail MCP tool names (search_threads, get_thread, create_draft, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GMAIL_MCP_URL with GMAIL_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The 12 Google Gmail MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical gmail.<operation> names.

connections.title: Gmail REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Gmail client's root URL at GMAIL_API_BASE_URL and send GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Routes live under /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/... with userId `me`. Test processes only; OAuth is not emulated.
